purpose: Test whether fixed, checksum-valid Kraken depth-10 orderbook state adds useful confirmation context on the preregistered H3 symbols without thresholds, transforms, pair ranking, model change, extra candidate discovery, orders or baseline mutation.

candidate_stream.source: same canonical candidate stream as the active comparison baseline/successor runtime
candidate_stream.eligible_pair_behavior: Apply H3 context only to preregistered supported pairs; all other candidates are baseline passthrough and are excluded from the H3 eligible-sample count.

supported_pairs.selection_basis: Exact symbols frozen before the completed V3-H3-ASSOC-002 prospective association trial; no outcome-driven pair expansion or pruning.

source_contract.reconciliation: apply levels -> trim depth10 -> validate Kraken CRC32 before state is eligible
source_contract.state_rule: latest checksum-valid reconciled state at or before the candidate evaluation clock

fixed_features.spread_bps: raw fixed feature from the H3 state contract
fixed_features.bid_depth_quote_top10: raw fixed feature from the H3 state contract
fixed_features.ask_depth_quote_top10: raw fixed feature from the H3 state contract
fixed_features.depth_imbalance_top10: raw fixed feature from the H3 state contract

pilot_gate.low_impact_rule: If fewer than 3 baseline-vs-H3 decision divergences occur by the minimum gate, classify INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_IMPACT; do not tune or auto-extend.
pilot_gate.fasttrack_note: No arbitrary fixed day-count floor. Review as soon as the sample, temporal-diversity and integrity gates are met.
pilot_gate.promotion_limit: This is a bounded shadow feasibility/value pilot only; it cannot directly promote H3 into a live or paper strategy.

operational_feasibility_snapshot.source: Supabase paper_candidate_outcomes for PAPER-V2R3-CLEAN-20261001T0925Z; candidate incidence only, not outcome selection
operational_feasibility_snapshot.gate_rationale: Twenty eligible candidates across at least two UTC dates is a short, bounded pilot sized to the observed incidence. Any positive result still requires a later stronger evidence gate before promotion.

cost_reference.note: Same conservative reference used by the baseline research path; no actual orders are created by this pilot.
